# A low grey boulder 0.7 x 0.5 x 0.35 m. Static.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.5255 0.5059 0.5333 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.35 --location 0 0 0.12
scale 1.0 0.75 0.6
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.04 --seed 3
mode object
material assign Stone
select all
shade flat
export rock.glb
